name: Animal Souls
overview: Scripture distinguishes between man and animals by highlighting that while all living creatures are given life by God and are called living souls, man alone is created in God's image and endowed with dominion over the earth and its creatures. Genesis reveals that animals possess life and are cared for by the righteous, yet the spirit of man ascends to God, contrasting with the spirit of animals which returns to the earth. This underscores both the shared vitality of animals and the unique spiritual nature and responsibility bestowed upon humanity.
